entries.en: She abandoned the novel because its sado-masochistic themes upset her.
entries.zh: 她读不下去那本小说，因为其中施虐受虐的主题让她不适。

entries.en: The club welcomed both same-sex and mixed doubles teams.
entries.zh: 俱乐部既欢迎同性别的双打组合，也欢迎混合双打组合。

entries.meaningZh: 单调雷同的〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The hotel rooms felt samey, despite their different paint colours.
entries.zh: 那些酒店客房虽然刷着不同颜色的漆，却显得单调雷同。

entries.en: She was sated with praise and wanted some honest criticism.
entries.zh: 赞美听得腻了，她想听一些诚恳的批评。

entries.en: A schooled voice can still sound warm and spontaneous.
entries.zh: 受过训练的嗓音依然可以听起来温暖而自然。

entries.en: Scot-free and unrepentant, the prankster waved at the cameras.
entries.zh: 那名恶作剧者既未受罚，也毫无悔意，还向镜头挥手。

entries.en: Screenwriting paid her rent while she worked on her first novel.
entries.zh: 她创作第一部小说期间，靠电影剧本创作支付房租。

entries.en: Keep the spare buttons in a screw-top jar.
entries.zh: 把备用纽扣放在一个带螺旋盖的罐子里。

entries.en: I felt too screwed up to discuss the argument calmly.
entries.zh: 我心绪太乱，无法平静地谈论那场争吵。

entries.en: Her patience with nervous beginners is second to none.
entries.zh: 她对紧张的初学者所表现出的耐心无人能及。

entries.en: The actor's fake second-degree burn looked alarmingly real under the stage lights.
entries.zh: 演员身上那处假的二度烧伤，在舞台灯光下逼真得令人心惊。

entries.en: The library keeps its self-access language materials near the entrance.
entries.zh: 图书馆把供自主学习的语言材料放在入口附近。

entries.en: She sealed each envelope with a self-adhesive label.
entries.zh: 她用一张自粘标签封住了每个信封。

entries.en: Our self-assembly desk arrived in three flat boxes.
entries.zh: 我们那张需自行组装的书桌装在三个扁箱子里送来了。

entries.en: We rented a self-catering cottage with a small kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们租了一间带小厨房、需自行安排膳食的乡间小屋。

entries.en: His self-congratulatory speech barely mentioned the rest of the team.
entries.zh: 他那番自我吹嘘的讲话几乎没有提到团队的其他人。

entries.en: Usually self-controlled, Mira surprised everyone by shouting back.
entries.zh: 米拉一向很有自制力，这次却大声回嘴，让大家吃了一惊。

entries.en: The self-declared expert could not answer the simplest question.
entries.zh: 那个自称专家的人连最简单的问题都答不上来。

entries.meaningZh: 供租用者自行驾驶的〔英式〕
entries.en: They booked a self-drive van to collect the furniture.
entries.zh: 他们租了一辆自行驾驶的货车去取家具。

entries.en: Their fear of losing became a self-fulfilling prophecy when they stopped practising.
entries.zh: 他们因为害怕输而不再练习，结果恐惧真的应验了。

entries.en: The delay was self-inflicted; we had ignored three reminders.
entries.zh: 这次延误是我们自己造成的；此前我们无视了三次提醒。

entries.en: Her apparently generous offer had a self-interested motive.
entries.zh: 她那看似慷慨的提议背后有着自私自利的动机。

entries.en: My self-obsessed flatmate never asks how anyone else is feeling.
entries.zh: 我那个只顾自己的室友从不问别人心情如何。

entries.en: He deleted the self-pitying message before sending it.
entries.zh: 他在发送前删掉了那条充满自怜的消息。

entries.meaningZh: 自指的〔作品谈及自身创作〕
entries.en: In a self-referential scene, the film's narrator argues with its director.
entries.zh: 在一个自指的场景中，电影的叙述者与导演争论起来。

entries.en: The model includes a self-regulatory mechanism that limits sudden swings.
entries.zh: 这个模型包含一种限制剧烈波动的自我调节机制。

entries.en: We returned to the self-same bench where we had first met.
entries.zh: 我们又回到了初次见面时坐过的那张长椅。

entries.en: The display uses self-standing panels rather than frames attached to the wall.
entries.zh: 展览采用能自行立稳的展板，而不是固定在墙上的框架。

entries.en: The self-taught carpenter built every shelf in the house.
entries.zh: 那位自学成才的木匠做了屋里的每一块搁板。

entries.meaningZh: 只售不租的〔旧式录像带销售用语〕
entries.en: The shop kept its sell-through videos separate from the rental collection.
entries.zh: 商店把只售不租的录像带与出租录像带分开放。

entries.en: Our semi-annual reunion falls in May and November.
entries.zh: 我们每半年一次的聚会分别在五月和十一月举行。

entries.meaningZh: 半独立式的〔房屋与另一栋共墙〕
entries.en: They bought a semi-detached house beside a quiet lane.
entries.zh: 他们在一条安静的小巷旁买了一栋半独立式住宅。

entries.en: She chose semi-precious stones for the handmade necklace.
entries.zh: 她选了半宝石来制作那条手工项链。

entries.en: The semi-professional drummer teaches during the week and performs on weekends.
entries.zh: 那位半职业鼓手平日教课，周末演出。

entries.en: The designer filled the courtyard with semi-tropical plants.
entries.zh: 设计师在庭院里种满了亚热带植物。

entries.en: A sequinned jacket glittered under the stage lights.
entries.zh: 一件缀亮片的夹克在舞台灯光下闪闪发亮。

entries.en: The defeated players sat shell-shocked in the empty changing room.
entries.zh: 失利的球员们惊愕地坐在空荡荡的更衣室里。

entries.en: Another shock horror headline stared up from the breakfast table.
entries.zh: 早餐桌上的报纸又登着一条骇人听闻的大标题。

entries.en: I was short of breath after running for the bus.
entries.zh: 我跑着赶公交车后气喘吁吁。

entries.en: She prefers trains to short-haul flights whenever time allows.
entries.zh: 只要时间允许，她就更愿意坐火车而不是乘短途航班。

entries.en: The cafe was shorthanded, so the owner washed dishes herself.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆人手不足，店主便亲自洗碗。

entries.en: A shoulder-high fence separates the vegetable patch from the path.
entries.zh: 一道齐肩高的篱笆把菜地和小路隔开。

entries.en: Her shoulder-length hair kept catching on the bag strap.
entries.zh: 她齐肩长的头发总是被包带勾住。

entries.en: The bakery's show-stopping window display drew a small crowd.
entries.zh: 面包店精彩出众的橱窗陈列吸引了一小群人。

entries.meaningZh: 精彩得引来掌声而使演出暂停的
entries.en: Her showstopping solo drew such applause that the orchestra had to pause.
entries.zh: 她的独奏精彩得让观众掌声不断，乐队不得不停下来。

entries.en: The books arrived shrink-wrapped, with their corners still perfectly sharp.
entries.zh: 这些书送来时用收缩薄膜包着，书角依然完好挺括。

entries.en: The collection was fifty pounds shy of its target.
entries.zh: 这次募款离目标还差五十英镑。

entries.en: His side-splitting impression of the headmaster broke the tense silence.
entries.zh: 他模仿校长，滑稽得令人捧腹，打破了紧张的沉默。

entries.en: A lone cyclist was silhouetted against the pale evening sky.
entries.zh: 一名独行的骑车人在淡淡的暮色天空下显出剪影。

entries.en: The silver-plated tray belonged to my grandmother.
entries.zh: 那个镀银托盘曾是我祖母的。

entries.en: She moved from a single-sex school to a mixed college.
entries.zh: 她从一所单一性别学校转入了一所男女同校的学院。

entries.meaningZh: 处境十分有利的〔非正式〕
entries.en: With the rent paid for a year, we were sitting pretty.
entries.zh: 房租已经付了一整年，我们的处境十分有利。

entries.en: The children stood slack-jawed as the enormous puppet entered.
entries.zh: 那个巨大的木偶进场时，孩子们站在那里，惊得目瞪口呆。

entries.en: By midnight, the exhausted volunteers were slap-happy and laughing at nothing.
entries.zh: 到了午夜，精疲力竭的志愿者们开始傻乐呵，无缘无故地笑。

entries.en: Sunlight filtered through the slatted shutters onto the floor.
entries.zh: 阳光透过板条百叶窗洒到地板上。

entries.en: She grew tired of conversations that always returned to slimming.
entries.zh: 她厌倦了那些总绕回减肥话题的谈话。

entries.en: We were slow off the mark and missed the cheapest tickets.
entries.zh: 我们行动迟缓，错过了最便宜的票。

entries.en: The jeweller repaired the window after a smash-and-grab raid.
entries.zh: 遭到一次砸窗盗窃后，珠宝商修好了橱窗。

entries.en: She folded the baby's smocked dress and laid it in the drawer.
entries.zh: 她把婴儿那条带褶绣的连衣裙叠好，放进抽屉。

entries.en: A smooth-talking salesman persuaded him to buy the larger model.
entries.zh: 一个巧舌如簧的销售员说服他买下了更大的型号。

entries.meaningZh: 忙得不可开交的〔非正式〕
entries.en: I'm snowed under this week, but I can help on Monday.
entries.zh: 我这周忙得不可开交，不过星期一可以帮忙。

entries.en: So many empty seats made the small theatre feel enormous.
entries.zh: 那么多空座位让这家小剧场显得格外空旷。

entries.en: The candidates debated social democratic policies at the student forum.
entries.zh: 候选人在学生论坛上辩论了社会民主主义的政策。

entries.en: The exhibition explores the socio-political tensions behind the strike.
entries.zh: 这个展览探讨了那次罢工背后的社会政治矛盾。

entries.en: She found the film's soft-core scenes embarrassing rather than romantic.
entries.zh: 她觉得电影里那些含蓄描写性的场景令人尴尬，并不浪漫。

entries.en: My soft-hearted neighbour could never turn away a hungry stray.
entries.zh: 我那位心肠软的邻居从不忍心赶走饥饿的流浪动物。

entries.meaningZh: 小心谨慎的〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: Her softly-softly approach eventually won the nervous child's trust.
entries.zh: 她小心谨慎的做法最终赢得了那个紧张的孩子的信任。

entries.en: We reached the cabin sopping wet and desperate for dry socks.
entries.zh: 我们浑身湿透地来到小屋，急着找干袜子换上。

entries.meaningZh: 经改装而性能增强的〔非正式〕
entries.en: His souped-up car made conversation impossible whenever the engine started.
entries.zh: 他那辆改装过的汽车一启动，吵得人根本无法交谈。

entries.en: The path takes a south-easterly course beyond the bridge.
entries.zh: 过桥后，小路朝东南方向延伸。

entries.en: A south-westerly wind pushed the smoke towards the village.
entries.zh: 一阵西南风把烟吹向村庄。

entries.en: The map shows a footpath along the lake's south-western shore.
entries.zh: 地图显示，湖的西南岸有一条步道。

entries.meaningZh: 特殊需求〔身心障碍等所需的额外支持〕
entries.en: The school asked families about any special needs before planning the trip.
entries.zh: 学校在安排出游前，向各家庭询问了孩子是否有特殊需求。

entries.en: A pot of spiced tea warmed on the stove.
entries.zh: 一壶加了香料的茶正在炉子上温着。

entries.en: A spine-chilling scream cut through the silence of the play.
entries.zh: 一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫打破了剧中的寂静。

entries.en: The choir gave a spine-tingling performance of the final song.
entries.zh: 合唱团对最后一首歌的演绎扣人心弦。

entries.en: Their split-level apartment has three steps between the kitchen and sitting room.
entries.zh: 他们的错层式公寓里，厨房和客厅之间有三级台阶。

entries.en: He lay spreadeagled on the rug after carrying the last box upstairs.
entries.zh: 把最后一箱东西搬上楼后，他四肢摊开地躺在地毯上。

entries.en: She inspected the newly spun yarn before winding it onto a spool.
entries.zh: 她先检查新纺成的纱线，再把它绕在线轴上。

entries.en: The kitchen was squeaky clean before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，厨房已经打扫得一尘不染。

entries.en: The stagestruck teenager volunteered for every role in the school play.
entries.zh: 那个一心想当演员的少年主动报名，愿意演校剧里的任何角色。

entries.en: We were staggered by the price of the tiny painting.
entries.zh: 那幅小画的价格让我们惊愕不已。

entries.en: His stammering apology faded into silence when nobody answered.
entries.zh: 没有人回应，他结结巴巴地道歉，后来便没了声音。

entries.en: She treasured a stamped postcard whose postmark recalled their first holiday.
entries.zh: 她珍藏着一张盖有邮戳的明信片，那枚邮戳让她想起两人的首次度假。

entries.en: He seemed stand-offish at first, but soon joined our conversation.
entries.zh: 他起初显得冷淡疏远，但很快就加入了我们的谈话。

entries.en: We spread a blanket beneath the star-studded sky.
entries.zh: 我们在繁星点点的夜空下铺开一条毯子。

entries.en: His starched collar rubbed against his neck throughout dinner.
entries.zh: 整个晚餐期间，他那浆得硬挺的衣领一直磨着脖子。

entries.en: The starstruck fans fell silent when the singer walked past.
entries.zh: 那位歌手走过时，激动的歌迷们一下子安静了下来。

entries.en: There's no need to get steamed-up over a missing teaspoon.
entries.zh: 不必为少了一把茶匙就这么生气。

entries.en: A stomach-churning smell drifted from the forgotten rubbish bag.
entries.zh: 一股令人反胃的气味从那个被遗忘的垃圾袋里飘了出来。

entries.en: Her grandfather was stone deaf, so she wrote the invitation on a card.
entries.zh: 她的祖父完全失聪，所以她把邀请写在了一张卡片上。

entries.meaningZh: 滴酒未沾而清醒的〔非正式〕
entries.en: I was stone-cold sober when I agreed to sing onstage.
entries.zh: 我答应上台唱歌时滴酒未沾，头脑完全清醒。

entries.en: The baker dusted the counter with stone-ground flour.
entries.zh: 面包师在操作台上撒了些石磨面粉。

entries.en: He wore stone-washed jeans and a faded green shirt.
entries.zh: 他穿着石磨水洗牛仔裤和一件褪色的绿色衬衫。

entries.en: Frequent reversals exposed the cost of the government's stop-go economic policy.
entries.zh: 频繁反复暴露了政府时紧时松的经济政策所带来的代价。

entries.en: She remained straight-faced while everyone else laughed at the joke.
entries.zh: 其他人听到那个笑话都笑了，她却依旧一本正经。

entries.en: They sold the piano when straitened circumstances forced them to move.
entries.zh: 经济拮据迫使他们搬家时，他们卖掉了钢琴。

entries.en: I'm strapped for cash until Friday, so let's eat at home.
entries.zh: 星期五以前我手头很紧，所以咱们在家吃吧。

entries.en: She looked stressed out after a morning of cancelled appointments.
entries.zh: 整个上午的预约接连取消后，她看上去压力很大。

entries.en: The villain treated prisoners as sub-human, a cruelty the novel condemns.
entries.zh: 那个反派不把囚犯当人看，小说对这种残暴予以谴责。

entries.en: The inspector rejected the sub-standard timber before construction began.
entries.zh: 检查员在施工开始前就退回了那批不合标准的木材。

entries.en: The conservatory houses a collection of sub-tropical plants.
entries.zh: 温室里种着一批亚热带植物。

entries.en: Sub-zero temperatures left a thin crust of ice on the pond.
entries.zh: 零下的气温让池塘表面结了一层薄冰。

entries.en: She submitted a subtitled essay called Home: A Journey Back.
entries.zh: 她交了一篇带副标题的文章，题为《故乡：归途》。

entries.en: We packed extra blankets for the forecast subzero nights.
entries.zh: 预报夜间气温会降到零下，我们多带了几条毯子。

entries.en: The cart rattled over the sun-baked earth.
entries.zh: 车子在晒干的土地上颠簸着前行。

entries.en: They ate breakfast on a sundrenched balcony overlooking the garden.
entries.zh: 他们在洒满阳光、俯瞰花园的阳台上吃早餐。

entries.en: The cabin was generously supplied with blankets and dry firewood.
entries.zh: 小屋里备有充足的毯子和干柴。

entries.en: The novel opens with the discovery of an abandoned surface-to-surface missile.
entries.zh: 小说以发现一枚被遗弃的地对地导弹开篇。

entries.en: A switched-on assistant spotted the duplicate booking before it caused trouble.
entries.zh: 一位机警的助理在重复预订惹出麻烦前就发现了它。

entries.en: He arrived tanked and promptly fell asleep in an armchair.
entries.zh: 他醉醺醺地到了这里，随即就在扶手椅上睡着了。

entries.en: The tarred fence glistened in the afternoon sun.
entries.zh: 涂了焦油的篱笆在午后的阳光下泛着亮光。

entries.meaningZh: 可在计算所得税时扣除的
entries.en: The accountant asked whether the donation was tax-deductible.
entries.zh: 会计师询问这笔捐款能否在计算所得税时扣除。

entries.meaningZh: 液面高度指示牌〔技术用语〕
entries.en: The tank's tell-tale showed that the liquid level had fallen overnight.
entries.zh: 储罐的液面高度指示牌显示，液位在夜间下降了。

entries.en: The tender-hearted guard quietly brought the lost child a blanket.
entries.zh: 那位心地仁慈的保安悄悄给迷路的孩子拿来了一条毯子。

entries.en: Rain drummed on the roof of the tented dining area.
entries.zh: 雨点咚咚地敲打着帐篷餐区的篷顶。

entries.en: We looked the worse for wear after the overnight journey.
entries.zh: 一夜旅程过后，我们看起来疲惫不堪。

entries.en: Volunteers were thin on the ground during the holiday weekend.
entries.zh: 假期周末期间，志愿者很少。

entries.en: Our tight-fisted landlord complained about the cost of a single light bulb.
entries.zh: 我们那位吝啬的房东连一个灯泡的价钱都要抱怨。

entries.en: The organisers remained tight-lipped about the surprise guest.
entries.zh: 组织者对那位神秘嘉宾的身份始终守口如瓶。

entries.en: She set the photograph on a time-worn wooden chest.
entries.zh: 她把照片放在一个年深日久、已经破旧的木箱上。

entries.en: My fingers felt tingly after gripping the icy railing.
entries.zh: 握过冰冷的栏杆后，我的手指有些刺痛。

entries.en: The mechanic returned the old bicycle in tip-top condition.
entries.zh: 修车师傅把那辆旧自行车修得状态极佳，交还给了我。

entries.en: For years to come, she would remember that small act of kindness.
entries.zh: 在未来的许多年里，她都会记得那个小小的善举。

entries.en: With two miles to go, the children were already cheering.
entries.zh: 还剩两英里时，孩子们就已经欢呼起来了。

entries.en: His toe-curling attempt at a joke left the room silent.
entries.zh: 他硬讲的那个笑话尴尬极了，让整个房间鸦雀无声。

entries.meaningZh: 超出某人承受或应付能力的
entries.en: The heavy suitcase was too much for me to lift alone.
entries.zh: 那个沉重的行李箱太重，我一个人提不起来。

entries.en: The folder was marked top secret and kept on an isolated computer.
entries.zh: 那个文件夹标着“绝密”，存放在一台隔离的电脑上。

entries.en: Her top-drawer connections opened doors that money alone could not.
entries.zh: 她与上流人物的人脉打开了单靠金钱无法打开的大门。

entries.en: The top-ranked player lost the opening set but won the match.
entries.zh: 排名第一的那位选手虽然输掉了首盘，却赢得了比赛。

entries.en: The course attracted top-ranking musicians from several orchestras.
entries.zh: 这门课程吸引了好几个乐团的一流音乐家。

entries.en: The station moved its top-rated comedy to Friday evening.
entries.zh: 电视台把最受欢迎的喜剧节目调到了星期五晚上。

entries.en: She replaced the rotary telephone with a touch-tone model.
entries.zh: 她把拨号盘电话换成了一部按键式电话。

entries.en: Our track and field coach keeps spare spikes in her office.
entries.zh: 我们的田径教练在办公室里备着几双钉鞋。

entries.en: Her trail-blazing design inspired a generation of young architects.
entries.zh: 她那开创性的设计启发了一代年轻建筑师。

entries.en: A travelling theatre company performed in the village hall.
entries.zh: 一个巡回剧团在村庄礼堂里演出了。

entries.en: We followed a tree-lined avenue to the old house.
entries.zh: 我们沿着一条绿树成行的大道走到了那栋老房子。

entries.meaningZh: 涓滴效应的〔上层利益向下传递的理论〕
entries.en: The seminar challenged the mayor's faith in trickle-down economics.
entries.zh: 研讨会上，有人对市长所信奉的涓滴经济学提出了质疑。

entries.en: He pulled a crumpled ticket from his trouser pocket.
entries.zh: 他从裤袋里掏出了一张皱巴巴的票。

entries.en: The audience stayed tuned in throughout the long discussion.
entries.zh: 整个漫长的讨论过程中，听众始终保持专注。

entries.en: The garage had a turbo-charged engine on display.
entries.zh: 那家修车厂里陈列着一台装有涡轮增压器的发动机。

entries.en: One turn-up had come undone and was dragging in the dust.
entries.zh: 一边裤脚的翻边散开了，拖在灰尘里。

entries.en: The final vote became a two-horse race after the third candidate withdrew.
entries.zh: 第三位候选人退出后，最后的投票变成了两人的角逐。

entries.en: A typewritten letter lay beside the old photograph.
entries.zh: 一封用打字机打出的信放在那张旧照片旁边。

entries.en: Two library keys are still unaccounted for after the move.
entries.zh: 搬迁之后，图书馆还有两把钥匙下落不明。

entries.en: That cruel remark was completely uncalled for.
entries.zh: 那句刻薄的话完全是无理取闹。

entries.en: The garden looked uncared for, with weeds covering the path.
entries.zh: 那座花园看起来无人照料，小路上长满了杂草。

entries.en: The farmer brought another field under the plough that spring.
entries.zh: 那年春天，农场主又开耕了一块田。

entries.en: The undersigned residents request a meeting about the proposed road.
entries.zh: 在下方签名的居民要求就拟建道路举行会议。

entries.en: We were underwhelmed by the expensive room's view of a brick wall.
entries.zh: 那间昂贵客房窗外只有一堵砖墙，我们颇感失望。

entries.en: The announcement received an underwhelming response from the assembled members.
entries.zh: 与会会员对那则公告反应冷淡。

entries.en: Such a long delay was unheard of at our tiny station.
entries.zh: 我们这个小车站从未有过这么长的延误。

entries.en: The damaged recording became unlistenable halfway through the song.
entries.zh: 那段受损录音放到歌曲中途就变得难以入耳。

entries.en: The hostel advertised unmetered internet access for all its guests.
entries.zh: 旅舍宣传称，所有住客均可使用不按流量收费的网络。

entries.en: An unsettling silence followed the knock at the door.
entries.zh: 敲门声过后，是一阵令人不安的寂静。

entries.en: The unveiling ceremony took place in the courtyard at noon.
entries.zh: 揭幕仪式于中午在庭院里举行。

entries.en: The receptionist's unwelcoming manner made us reluctant to ask for help.
entries.zh: 接待员冷淡不友善的态度让我们不愿开口求助。

entries.en: By the weekend, she was up and about again, watering her plants.
entries.zh: 到了周末，她病后已经又能下床活动，给花草浇水了。

entries.en: Please check that the address list is up to date.
entries.zh: 请检查地址清单是否已经更新。

entries.en: The first rehearsal wasn't up to scratch, so we tried again.
entries.zh: 第一次排练没有达到标准，所以我们又试了一遍。

entries.en: The band opened with an up-tempo song that filled the dance floor.
entries.zh: 乐队以一首快节奏的歌曲开场，舞池里很快挤满了人。

entries.en: She chose an upholstered bench for the reading corner.
entries.zh: 她为阅读角选了一张带软垫的长凳。

entries.meaningZh: 社会经济地位上升中的
entries.en: The novel follows an upwardly mobile family uneasy about its new wealth.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个社会经济地位不断上升、却对新财富感到不安的家庭。

entries.en: The vacuum-packed blanket expanded as soon as she opened the bag.
entries.zh: 她一打开袋子，那条真空包装的毯子就膨胀开了。

entries.en: The hotel's much vaunted breakfast turned out to be cold toast.
entries.zh: 酒店大肆吹嘘的早餐，结果只是冷吐司。

entries.en: The vying candidates shook hands before their televised debate.
entries.zh: 互相竞争的候选人在电视辩论开始前握了手。

entries.en: Waged workers received lunch vouchers, while volunteers brought their own food.
entries.zh: 领取工资的工人拿到了午餐券，志愿者则自己带饭。

entries.en: Wall-to-wall carpeting muffled our footsteps in the corridor.
entries.zh: 走廊里满铺的地毯减轻了我们的脚步声。

entries.en: Beyond the bridge lay a small walled town with narrow gates.
entries.zh: 桥外是一座有城墙的小镇，城门很窄。

entries.en: A warm-hearted stranger helped us carry the broken bicycle home.
entries.zh: 一位热心善良的陌生人帮我们把坏掉的自行车抬回了家。

entries.meaningZh: 有担保的〔旧式商业用语〕
entries.en: The dealer sold warranted watches but offered no guarantee on loose parts.
entries.zh: 那个商人出售有担保的手表，但不为零散配件提供保证。

entries.en: Critics called him washed up, but his next play filled the theatre.
entries.zh: 评论家说他的事业已经完了，但他下一部戏却让剧场座无虚席。

entries.en: She hung her welding gloves beside the workshop door.
entries.zh: 她把焊接手套挂在了车间门边。

entries.en: You would be well advised to keep a copy of the receipt.
entries.zh: 你最好留一份收据副本，这样做比较明智。

entries.en: If you can finish today, that's well and good.
entries.zh: 如果你今天能做完，那也很好。

entries.en: The committee seemed well disposed towards our modest proposal.
entries.zh: 委员会似乎对我们那份不张扬的提案抱有好感。

entries.en: The repair was well done and almost impossible to spot.
entries.zh: 这次修补做得很好，几乎看不出痕迹。

entries.en: Her reputation for fairness was well earned, not merely inherited.
entries.zh: 她处事公正的名声是完全凭自己赢得的，并非只是承袭而来。

entries.meaningZh: 出身名门的〔旧时社会用语〕
entries.en: The well-born heroine rejects the marriage her relatives have arranged.
entries.zh: 那位出身名门的女主人公拒绝了亲戚安排的婚事。

entries.en: The well-brought-up children thanked the driver before leaving the bus.
entries.zh: 那些有教养的孩子下车前向司机道了谢。

entries.en: The well-built shed survived the storm without losing a single panel.
entries.zh: 那座建造坚固的棚屋经受住了暴风雨，连一块板都没掉。

entries.en: After repairing the roof, they sat down for a well-earned rest.
entries.zh: 修好屋顶后，他们坐下来，享受一番应得的休息。

entries.en: The lecture began with well-established facts before moving to disputed theories.
entries.zh: 讲座先讲了已经得到确认的事实，再转向有争议的理论。

entries.en: He was well-hung, but his constant boasting spoiled the evening.
entries.zh: 他虽然阴茎很大，却因为不停地吹嘘而毁了那个夜晚的气氛。

entries.en: A well-thumbed cookbook lay open beside the mixing bowl.
entries.zh: 一本翻得破旧的食谱摊在搅拌碗旁边。

entries.en: Our well-travelled aunt always has a story for every photograph.
entries.zh: 我们那位游历广泛的姑妈，每张照片背后都有一个故事可讲。

entries.en: We left the well-trodden path and crossed the meadow.
entries.zh: 我们离开那条常有人走的小路，穿过了草地。

entries.en: I was wet behind the ears and trusted every promise they made.
entries.zh: 那时我初出茅庐，他们说什么我都信。

entries.en: The coach journey became a white-knuckle ride along the narrow mountain road.
entries.zh: 长途汽车沿狭窄山路行驶，让这趟旅程变得惊险紧张。

entries.meaningZh: 采用最新技术的〔非正式〕
entries.en: The shop's whizzy new tills confused the staff on their first morning.
entries.zh: 商店那些采用最新技术的新收银机，第一天上午就把员工弄糊涂了。
